profile.headline: Final-Year Information Systems Engineering Student | Backend, Frontend & AI Automation
profile.bio: Final-year Information Systems Engineering student with hands-on experience in backend and frontend development, automation workflows, and agile methodologies. I've worked in technical teams contributing to scalable software solutions, web applications, and AI-driven automations. Passionate about continuous learning, problem-solving, and building software that actually works in production.

projects.title: Syscow
projects.summary: Livestock management platform: Rails 8 API with JWT auth and a Next.js frontend.
projects.description: A system for managing cattle operations: animals, lots, fields, breeds, vaccinations, treatments, and weight/feed records. Backend built with Ruby on Rails 8, Devise + JWT auth, and policy-based authorization (Pundit); frontend in Next.js consuming the API. Deployed on a self-managed VPS behind Traefik, with automatic HTTPS via Let's Encrypt.

projects.title: Car price estimator pipeline
projects.summary: Data pipeline built with Apache Airflow to estimate used car prices.
projects.description: Capstone project at UTN (team of 3): an Airflow-orchestrated pipeline that processes and models used car data to estimate market price. Built collaboratively applying data engineering best practices.

projects.title: Administrative management system

projects.description: Personal project (2025): a Ruby on Rails web application for managing appointments and administrative processes, applying object-oriented programming, MVC architecture, and a frontend built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript.
